heroHeadline: FDA Classifies Taylor Farms Lettuce Recall as Class I, Its Most Serious Designation
heroSubtitle: FDA formally upgrades its July 17 recall of Taylor Farms de México iceberg lettuce to Class I — the agency's most serious recall category — citing the outbreak's unprecedented scale rather than any new positive product test. As of CDC's Aug 27 update, the Taylor Farms/Taco Bell multistate outbreak stands at 11,458 confirmed illnesses across 20 states with 495 hospitalizations and 2 unchanged deaths in Michigan, while the broader season-wide tally across all Cyclospora clusters reached 29,024 combined cases (17,180 lab-confirmed) across 48 states as of Aug 25.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
